description: S3 bucket is not protected by all effective Block Public Access settings
rationale: At least one of the four observed effective account-or-bucket Block Public Access settings is false. Effective flags indicate preventative configuration, not a full assessment of object-level permissions or network access. Inaccessible settings remain unknown rather than compliant.
remediation: Review the account-level and bucket-level Block Public Access settings, document any explicit exceptions, and enable appropriate protections. Inspect S3 Access Points, MRAP, object ACLs and resource policies separately.
